name: RustGPT_Bench_40
description: A 40-item benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on Rust programming tasks, focusing on code generation, correctness, and debugging. It measures whether generated Rust programs compile and pass provided tests or satisfy problem specifications. The suite is intended to benchmark models' practical Rust coding proficiency across varied problem types.
reputation: A small community benchmark on Hugging Face for assessing Rust code generation; modest adoption but useful for targeted Rust evaluation.
